prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1263; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, if that's all right. You already have my claim information.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision occurred?
A: I was driving through an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas. I was turning left at a light with a green arrow, and a vehicle coming the other way hit the front of my car.
Q: Which direction were you traveling before the turn?
A: I was heading north, and I was going to turn west onto the cross street.
Q: Were you able to see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: I saw headlights, but I thought it was far enough away to make the turn. It was closer than I expected.
Q: Did the other driver stop, or did they try to avoid you?
A: They didn't stop until after the hit. I don't think they braked before it happened.
Q: Were there any witnesses that you're aware of?
A: There was a man in a parked car near the corner who came over afterward. I don't know if he saw it happen.
Q: Did you seek medical attention after the collision?
A: Yes. I went to the emergency room that evening because my right knee was swollen and I couldn't put weight on it.
Q: Can you describe the injury as best you understand it?
A: They said there was a ligament problem and some bruising. I've been using crutches and I have a follow-up with an orthopedic doctor next week.
Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?
A: Yes, I've been out since the collision. My job involves standing for most of the day, so I'm not able to do it right now.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was following the signal and I believe the other driver should have yielded or stopped in time.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
